rawContent: @Lexialex I felt it insulting for him to assume we are all out to punish innocent men. There is profound, overwhelming validity to the #metoo movement. Those who are afraid ought to question themselves and perhaps who they surround themselves with.

@SOCWFeminist @MaryG0401 @THR It pains me how misguided and (literally) ignorant comments about the Biz are. I'm seeing many more of them in light of Harvey Weinstein's exposure and the #metoo movement. Most of us did not sign up for the bs. Outsiders only hear about the top ppl who are famous. Its a small %.

@TheSpiritOfByBy @FestiGal77 "Diffusion of responsibility" explains why some people bystand w/o helping/getting involved in public. But (at least in my biz) it could also explain the emotional paralysis of a #metoo victim as the fear is that everyone WILL know and potentionally blackball one who speaks up.

I've dealt with a mountain of #metoo just like this. Saying "NO" (no matter how delicately) has been the reason I've been passed on, overlooked & forgotten in my career. @Illeanarama and everyone else affected, you have my support.  https://t.co/7plyaUHtMR

Drunk guy sat down in front of me while I'm talking to friends. He works in my industry. Can't stop touching my knee & squeezing it (I wore a dress). Kept zipping/unzipping my leather boots (nerves?). Now he's found & liked every remotely sexy picture on my Instagram. #metoo
